dossier.headline: IT turns from November laggard to four-day market leader
dossier.summary: IT had been November's weakest sector on AI worries, but it was the only sector to rise in Monday's 23 Nov sell-off and has led the market since. On 26 Nov IT stocks rose up to 3% early and the sector ended as the day's strongest, with HCLTech up 5.99% as the top Nifty gainer and Infosys, TCS and Wipro also higher.
why_it_matters: IT has supported the market on a down day and on both rebound days this week
Money has been rotating from AI-linked names into IT services stocks
